sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 Dealbook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

sentences.en: President Trump's plan to deregulate America is underway.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的美国去监管化计划正在进行中。

sentences.en: He's starting in the heart of America with one of Barack Obama's most cherished regulations.
sentences.zh: 他正从美国的心脏地带入手，针对巴拉克·奥巴马最珍视的法规之一开刀。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump and Angela Merkel meet for the first time.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普和安格拉·默克尔首次会面。

sentences.en: One embraced open borders.
sentences.zh: 一个拥抱开放边境。

sentences.en: The other is proudly closing them.
sentences.zh: 另一个则自豪地关闭边境。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月16日，星期四。

sentences.en: The assault on the American auto industry, believe me, is over.
sentences.zh: 相信我，对美国汽车工业的攻击已经结束了。

sentences.en: It's over.
sentences.zh: 结束了。

sentences.en: Not going to have it anymore.
sentences.zh: 以后不会再有了。

sentences.en: In a suburb of Detroit on Wednesday, a crowd of auto workers gathered as President Trump made good on a campaign promise.
sentences.zh: 周三，在底特律的一个郊区，一群汽车工人聚集在一起，见证特朗普总统兑现竞选承诺。

sentences.en: We're setting up a task force in every federal agency to identify and remove any regulation that undermines American auto production and any other kind of production.
sentences.zh: 我们正在每个联邦机构设立一个特别工作组，以识别并废除任何损害美国汽车生产及其他任何生产活动的法规。

sentences.en: It is a top priority for this White House, doing away with regulations on businesses, from Wall Street banks to gun manufacturers.
sentences.zh: 这是本届白宫的重中之重，即废除针对企业的监管，从华尔街银行到枪支制造商，无一例外。

sentences.en: Trump's top advisor, Steve Bannon, has called it the deconstruction of the administrative state.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的首席顾问史蒂夫·班农称之为“解构行政国家”。

sentences.en: Systematically unraveling a patchwork of rules that expanded dramatically under President Obama.
sentences.zh: 系统性地拆解在奥巴马总统任内急剧扩张的法规体系。

sentences.en: The way the progressive left runs is if they can't get it passed, they're just going to put it in some sort of regulation in an agency, that's all going to be deconstructed.
sentences.zh: 进步左派的运作方式是，如果他们无法通过立法，就会将其塞进某个机构的法规里，而这一切都将被解构。

sentences.en: Republican presidents have long pledged to rollback regulation.
sentences.zh: 共和党总统长期以来一直承诺要削减监管。

sentences.en: But for Donald
sentences.zh: 但对于唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump, it's personal.
sentences.zh: 特朗普来说，这是私人的事。

sentences.en: This is a guy who spent his entire career in the private sector as a private company, not even a publicly traded company.
sentences.zh: 他整个职业生涯都在私营部门，经营着一家私人公司，甚至不是一家上市公司。

sentences.en: And so he truly was his own boss.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实是自己的老板。

sentences.en: He did his own thing.
sentences.zh: 他按自己的方式行事。

sentences.en: And I think he wants to make the federal government more into that mold.
sentences.zh: 我想他想把联邦政府也塑造成那种模式。

sentences.en: Eric Lipton is an investigative reporter for The Times who's tracking every change in regulation under President Trump.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·利普顿是《纽约时报》的一名调查记者，他正在追踪特朗普总统任内每一项法规的变动。

sentences.en: There's a feeling among Republicans in particular and the business community that the Obama administration went way overboard in terms of setting rules in a way
sentences.zh: 共和党人和商界普遍有一种感觉，即奥巴马政府在制定规则方面做得太过火了，

sentences.en: that has led to such cost that it prevents businesses from being profitable and also from increasing employment potentially.
sentences.zh: 导致成本高昂，阻碍了企业盈利，也可能阻碍了就业增长。

sentences.en: I guess every president gets asked by American industry to roll back some set of regulations.
sentences.zh: 我想每位总统都会被美国工业界要求削减某些法规。

sentences.en: Is Trump just being much more responsive to those industry requests?
sentences.zh: 特朗普是否只是对这些行业诉求反应更积极？

sentences.en: Sometimes it's only a matter of days or weeks between the ask and the action.
sentences.zh: 有时从提出诉求到采取行动，仅仅相隔几天或几周。

sentences.en: And I mean, across more than a dozen different rules, I was able to find industry players from the NRA to major
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在十几种不同的规则中，我发现从美国全国步枪协会（NRA）到大型

sentences.en: corporations that didn't like rules on pay ratios regarding CEOs to, you know, broadband, where the industry said, we don't like this.
sentences.zh: 企业，他们不喜欢关于 CEO 薪酬比例的规定，或者像宽带行业，他们说，我们不喜欢这个。

sentences.en: And then very quickly, the rules are gone.
sentences.zh: 然后很快，这些规则就消失了。

sentences.en: So they ask, he acts.
sentences.zh: 所以他们提要求，他就行动。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I want to drill down on one example of these regulations Trump opposes, the fuel efficiency standards that he attacked yesterday in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我想深入探讨特朗普反对的这些法规中的一个例子，即他昨天在密歇根州抨击的燃油效率标准。

sentences.en: And before we talk about dismantling them.
sentences.zh: 在我们讨论拆除它们之前。

sentences.en: So for decades, the fuel efficiency standards of our cars and trucks was stuck in neutral.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，我们汽车和卡车的燃油效率标准一直处于停滞状态。

sentences.en: I want to talk with you about how they were constructed under the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 我想和你谈谈它们是在奥巴马政府下是如何制定的。

sentences.en: Well, in 2012, we set in motion the first ever national policy aimed at both increasing gas mileage
sentences.zh: 嗯，在2012年，我们启动了首个国家级政策，旨在提高燃油经济性

sentences.en: and decreasing greenhouse gas pollution for all new cars and trucks sold in the United States.
sentences.zh: 并减少在美国销售的所有新车和卡车的温室气体污染。

sentences.en: There was a informal agreement among the automakers and the Obama administration to try to improve the environment and reduce greenhouse gases.
sentences.zh: 汽车制造商和奥巴马政府之间达成了一项非正式协议，旨在改善环境并减少温室气体排放。

sentences.en: We're talking about 12 billion barrels of oil saved.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是节省了120亿桶石油。

sentences.en: These are numbers that are not to be sneezed at, ladies and gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，这些数字是不容小觑的。

sentences.en: And so that was the agreement.
sentences.zh: 这就是当时达成的协议。

sentences.en: The consumers agree.
sentences.zh: 消费者同意。

sentences.en: Labor agrees.
sentences.zh: 劳工组织同意。

sentences.en: The automakers agree.
sentences.zh: 汽车制造商同意。

sentences.en: Environmentalists agree.
sentences.zh: 环保人士同意。

sentences.en: The public agrees.
sentences.zh: 公众同意。

sentences.en: Everyone agrees that this is good for consumers, the industry, the nation.
sentences.zh: 每个人都同意这对消费者、行业和国家都有好处。

sentences.en: Then it took a number of years for the automakers and the EPA to actually write a rule.
sentences.zh: 后来，汽车制造商和环保署（EPA）花了几年时间才真正写出一条规则。

sentences.en: We saw the automakers standing up with the president.
sentences.zh: 我们看到汽车制造商与总统站在一起。

sentences.en: And that is now essentially in place.
sentences.zh: 而这现在基本上已经落实到位了。

sentences.en: We saw them touting this initiative because they knew that they could be producing cars that were more efficient and that consumers would want to purchase.
sentences.zh: 我们看到他们在大力宣传这一倡议，因为他们知道自己可以生产出更高效、消费者更愿意购买的汽车。

sentences.en: So now President Trump says he wants to undo those auto regulations.
sentences.zh: 所以现在特朗普总统说他想撤销那些汽车法规。

sentences.en: And I'm struck by how easy it seems for him to do that because Obama, when it came to the environment, did a lot of his rulemaking by executive order.
sentences.zh: 令我震惊的是，他做起来似乎如此容易，因为奥巴马在环境问题上，很多规则制定都是通过行政命令完成的。

sentences.en: And when you're in office, it would seem to me, that's great.
sentences.zh: 当你身居高位时，在我看来，这很棒。

sentences.en: But the problem is when there's a new executive, it doesn't seem so great anymore.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，当有了新的行政长官时，这似乎就不那么棒了。

sentences.en: Is that pretty much what's happening here?
sentences.zh: 这里发生的情况基本上就是这样吗？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Obama was quite frustrated by his inability to get things through Congress.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马对自己无法通过国会推动事情感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: As time passed, and especially towards his second term, he finally essentially lost patience and decided to do much of this through executive action.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，特别是在他的第二个任期内，他最终基本上失去了耐心，决定通过行政行动来完成大部分工作。

sentences.en: And he himself said, you know, you live by the pen, you die by the pen.
sentences.zh: 他自己也说过，你知道，以笔立命，亦以笔终结。

sentences.en: That's the situation he's now facing where Trump has come in and wants to roll back these same rules.
sentences.zh: 这就是他现在面临的情况，特朗普上台后想要撤销同样的规则。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, because once Trump is elected, it's not the person that President Obama had expected and hoped would win and would maintain these regulations.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，因为一旦特朗普当选，他就不是奥巴马总统所期望和希望获胜并维持这些法规的那个人了。

sentences.en: And in Trump's first couple of days in office, he took a meeting with...
sentences.zh: 在特朗普上任的头几天，他举行了一次会议……

sentences.en: I want to thank everybody.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢大家。

sentences.en: Perhaps we could go around the table, introduce ourselves and say, hello, I'll start.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以围着桌子，做个自我介绍，打个招呼，我先来。

sentences.en: I'm Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Mary, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 玛丽，请继续。

sentences.en: Mary Barra, chairman and CEO of General Motors.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·巴拉，通用汽车董事长兼首席执行官。

sentences.en: The top auto executives from the country.
sentences.zh: 全国顶尖的汽车高管们。

sentences.en: What is going on now from the auto company's CEO's point of view right now in the Roosevelt room in the West Wing?
sentences.zh: 从汽车公司首席执行官的角度来看，现在白宫西翼罗斯福厅里正在发生什么？

sentences.en: Right now, I think they're really starting to maybe establish a pretty friendly...
sentences.zh: 目前，我认为他们真的开始建立一种相当友好的……

sentences.en: What did they talk about in that meeting?
sentences.zh: 他们在会议上谈论了什么？

sentences.en: Among the things they talked about was the standard and their desire to see it rolled back.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的事情之一就是该标准，以及他们希望看到它被撤销的愿望。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things they're grousing about privately, and this could end up being
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们在私下里抱怨的一件事，而且这最终可能会变成

sentences.en: public, are the standards for fuel economy that were put into place under the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 公开的，就是奥巴马政府时期实施的燃油经济性标准。

sentences.en: They need to see that it's going to be a better place to do business, in their eyes, in order for them to invest more in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，他们需要看到这是一个更好的营商环境，以便他们在美国进行更多投资。

sentences.en: That's the bottom line.
sentences.zh: 这就是底线。

sentences.en: We're bringing manufacturing back to the United States big league.
sentences.zh: 我们正在大规模地将制造业带回美国。

sentences.en: We're reducing taxes very substantially, and we're reducing unnecessary regulations.
sentences.zh: 我们正在大幅减税，并减少不必要的监管。

sentences.en: And we want regulations, but we want real regulations that mean something.
sentences.zh: 我们需要监管，但我们想要的是真正有意义的监管。

sentences.en: We just had a great conversation with the president.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚与总统进行了一次很棒的谈话。

sentences.en: I think as an industry, we're excited about working together on regulation and on trade to really create a renaissance in American manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 我认为作为一个行业，我们很高兴能在监管和贸易方面共同努力，真正创造美国制造业的复兴。

sentences.en: So I have to ask, what exactly has changed for the automakers besides the person sitting in the Oval Office?
sentences.zh: 所以我必须问，除了坐在椭圆形办公室里的那个人之外，汽车制造商们到底发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: They argue that the technology involved has turned out to be more complicated and expensive than they had anticipated.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，所涉及的技术比他们预期的更复杂、更昂贵。

sentences.en: And also, consumers are driving cars that use more gasoline because the gasoline prices went down.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于汽油价格下跌，消费者正在驾驶耗油量更大的汽车。

sentences.en: And so they are facing consumer purchase desires that they want to be able to respond to by selling cars that are faster and heavier and therefore consume more gasoline.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们面临着消费者的购买需求，他们希望通过销售更快、更重的汽车来满足这些需求，而这些汽车因此消耗更多的汽油。

sentences.en: So they were now convinced that it was hurting their businesses.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在确信这正在损害他们的业务。

sentences.en: And they wanted the EPA to reevaluate it yet again, even though, in fact, the EPA had just completed such a reevaluation.
sentences.zh: 他们希望环保署再次重新评估，尽管事实上，环保署刚刚完成了这样的评估。

sentences.en: So they turned to the new head of the EPA and to the president and said, you know, let's essentially reconsider this.
sentences.zh: 所以他们转向环保署的新负责人和总统，说，你知道，让我们基本上重新考虑一下。

sentences.en: And that's what they're going to be doing.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他们要做的。

sentences.en: They're going to study it again.
sentences.zh: 他们要再次研究它。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a classic federal move.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是典型的联邦政府做法。

sentences.en: But when they say they're going to study it again, they're going to attempt to come up with sort of a scientific justification to roll back the requirement.
sentences.zh: 但当他们说要再次研究时，他们是打算找出一个科学依据来撤销该要求。

sentences.en: Which brings me to Scott Pruitt and what role he will play in all of this as the new head of the
sentences.zh: 这让我想到了斯科特·普鲁伊特，以及作为环保署新任负责人的他将在这一切中扮演什么角色，

sentences.en: Environmental Protection Agency, because he's somebody who has questioned the very point of the EPA.
sentences.zh: 因为他是一个质疑环保署存在意义的人。

sentences.en: So what role is he going to play in these auto emissions regulations?
sentences.zh: 那么他在这些汽车排放法规中将扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: Well, he's appointing all the people at the EPA who are going to oversee this process.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他正在任命环保署所有将监督这一过程的人员。

sentences.en: And he himself has openly questioned recently whether or not CO2 is a significant factor in climate change.
sentences.zh: 他本人最近也公开质疑二氧化碳是否是气候变化的重要因素。

sentences.en: No, I think that measuring with precision human activity on the climate is something very challenging to do.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为精确测量人类活动对气候的影响是一件非常有挑战性的事情。

sentences.en: And there's tremendous disagreement about the degree of impact.
sentences.zh: 而且对于影响程度存在巨大的分歧。

sentences.en: I mean, he argues that he just has a different scientific perspective.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他辩称他只是有不同的科学视角。

sentences.en: But we also know that he has a close alliance with a lot of the industry players from the oil and gas industry that want these changes.
sentences.zh: 但我们也知道，他与石油和天然气行业中许多想要这些改变的行业参与者有着密切的联盟。

sentences.en: And you're keeping really close track of this.
sentences.zh: 而且你一直在密切关注这一点。

sentences.en: Just how many regulations has President Trump started to roll back in just the month and a half or so he's been president?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统上任仅仅一个半月左右，就已经开始撤销多少项法规了？

sentences.en: I mean, as of a week ago, we had identified at least 90 rules that had been either nullified, suspended or delayed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，截至一周前，我们已经确定至少有90项规则被废除、暂停或推迟。

sentences.en: Everything from whether or not hybrid cars have to have a sound when they are driving because of concern that perhaps you could be hit by the car, to whether or not
sentences.zh: 从混合动力汽车在行驶时是否必须发出声音（因为担心可能会撞到人），到

sentences.en: streams need to be protected from coal mines.
sentences.zh: 溪流是否需要受到保护免受煤矿污染，应有尽有。

sentences.en: I mean, just about every sector of the economy, the rules are being suspended, delayed or nullified.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，几乎在经济的每个领域，规则都在被暂停、推迟或废除。

sentences.en: Today, I am announcing that we are going to cancel that executive action.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布我们将取消那项行政行动。

sentences.en: And we are going to ensure that any regulations we have protect and defend your jobs, your factories.
sentences.zh: 我们将确保我们拥有的任何法规都能保护和捍卫你们的工作岗位、你们的工厂。

sentences.en: We're going to be fair.
sentences.zh: 我们要公平。

sentences.en: We're going to be fair.
sentences.zh: 我们要公平。

sentences.en: This morning, President Trump will release his proposed federal budget for the next year.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，特朗普总统将发布他下一年度的联邦预算提案。

sentences.en: The Times reports that it will reduce funding for the Environmental Protection Agency by 31 percent.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，该预算将把环保署的资金削减31%。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。
